title: The Last Language
author: K. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Oscar Oyelaran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
